edges.reason: Ownership is assigned directly from msg.sender in the DSAuth constructor.
setOwner writes attacker-influenced owner_ into the owner storage slot.
setAuthority replaces the authority contract used for all authorization decisions.
isAuthorized evaluates msg.sender against address(this), owner and the authority.
The auth modifier gates setOwner on isAuthorized(msg.sender, msg.sig).
The auth modifier gates setAuthority on isAuthorized(msg.sender, msg.sig).
setAdminByAdmin validates msg.sender equals the current admin.
The admin slot is overwritten with the caller-supplied admin address.
kill is restricted by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
withdrawStuckFunds is restricted by onlyOwner against msg.sender.
withdrawStuckFunds performs the ETH/ERC20 transfer to owner.
kill executes selfdestruct(payable(owner)).
setAuthorized is onlyOwner-gated on msg.sender.
setAuthorized writes the approved flag into the authorized mapping.
ALL_AUTHORIZED short-circuits the per-address authorization used by DFSProxy.
givePermission grants execute authority based on the caller context of the proxy.
givePermission reads/writes the proxy authority to install a new DSGuard.
removePermission reads the current authority before forbidding the address.
Permission is granted for the execute(address,bytes) selector on the proxy.
callExecute is gated by onlyMonitor checking msg.sender.
The monitor slot is the caller identity required by callExecute.
callExecute forwards value and calldata into the user's DSProxy.execute.
Leftover ETH is transferred back to msg.sender after the execute call.
The arbitrary execute target can re-enter the monitor while value is still held.
changeMonitor stores block.timestamp as changeRequestedTimestamp.
changeMonitor records lastMonitor and the new monitor address.
confirmNewMonitor compares block.timestamp against changeRequestedTimestamp + CHANGE_PERIOD.
confirmNewMonitor commits newMonitor into the active monitor slot.
The allowed mapping gates who may start a monitor change.
The allowed mapping gates who may confirm a monitor change.
onlyAllowed checks msg.sender against the allowed mapping and owner.
DSProxyCache.write deploys arbitrary bytecode through inline assembly create.
callProxy authorizes the request by recovering the signer with ecrecover.
callProxy executes arbitrary proxy calldata after the signature check.
_user must equal both the recovered signer and the proxy owner.
_nonce is marked as consumed in the DFSProxy.nonces mapping.
The EIP712 digest is the message verified by ecrecover.
subscribe keys the subscription on msg.sender.
subscribe pushes or updates an entry in the subscribers array.
_unsubscribe performs swap-and-pop on the subscribers array.
_unsubscribe emits Unsubscribed(msg.sender) for the removed position.
_sell attempts the 0x order path through takeOrder.
_sell falls back to saverSwap when the 0x order fails.
_buy falls back to saverSwap when the 0x order fails.
takeOrder performs the low-level call to the 0x exchange address.
The low-level 0x call can re-enter the exchange contract before balances settle.
_ethAmount is the value attached to the 0x low-level call.
tokensSwapped is computed from balance deltas around the low-level call.
The ETH fee amount flows into the low-level call value.
takeOrder rewrites order calldata with writeUint256 assembly.
saverSwap invokes the wrapper sell/buy external call.
The wrapper external call executes before final balance checks.
SaverExchange.sell delegates the swap to _sell.
SaverExchange.sell charges the DFS fee before swapping.
getFee transfers the computed fee to the wallet.
getFee reads custom fee settings from the Discount mapping.
getFee selects the automatic fee tier based on tx.origin bot membership.
getFee transfers the ETH/token fee to WALLET_ADDR.
getFee queries BotRegistry.botList for tx.origin.
getFee reads the user's custom service fee from Discount.
AaveSaverProxy.repay swaps redeemed collateral through _sell.
AaveSaverProxy.repay deducts the service/gas fee via getFee.
daiBid calls the external flipper tend entrypoint.
_amount is multiplied by 10**27 without an overflow guard.
CompoundBasicProxy.withdraw forwards the full balance to msg.sender.
AaveBasicProxy.deposit pulls tokens from msg.sender with safeTransferFrom.
The Uniswap router deadline is derived from block.timestamp + 1.
UniswapV2Wrapper.sell performs external router swaps.
MCDSaverProxy.repay swaps drawn collateral through _sell.
MCDSaverProxy.repay uses DSMath arithmetic for fee and debt math.
CompoundSaverProxy.repay swaps redeemed collateral through _sell.
CompoundSaverProxy.repay uses DSMath helpers for fee arithmetic.
AaveImport.callFunction issues multiple DSProxy.execute external calls with value.

normalization_plan.reason: owner_ is only used as the argument written into DSAuth.owner by setOwner.
authority_ is only used as the argument written into DSAuth.authority by setAuthority.
_token selects the asset withdrawn by AdminAuth.withdrawStuckFunds.
_amount is only consumed by the AdminAuth.withdrawStuckFunds transfer.
_admin is only used to overwrite AdminAuth.admin inside setAdminByAdmin.
_contractAddr is only used to grant execute permission in givePermission.
currAuthority is a transient read of the proxy authority inside givePermission.
_ethAmount is only consumed by the takeOrder low-level call path.
tokensSwapped is the balance delta local to takeOrder.
_amount is only used as the fee basis inside AaveHelper.getFee.
_user is only used to query the Discount custom fee inside getFee.
feeAmount is the return local computed and capped inside getFee.
_user is only consumed by the signature/ownership checks in DFSProxy.callProxy.
_nonce is only consumed by the replay-protection write in DFSProxy.callProxy.
digest is the transient EIP712 hash verified inside DFSProxy.callProxy.
